record.edic_text:
4637 skenoo {skay-no'-o}

from 4636; TDNT - 7:385,1040; v

AV - dwell 5; 5

1) to fix one's tabernacle, have one's tabernacle, abide (or live) in
   a tabernacle (or tent), tabernacle
2) to dwell
